title: dnd-5e-2024 condition stats (docs/rulesets.md#conditions)
description: A condition, an SRD primitive in rules/condition/ or a custom extension under content/. Stored inputs only: the template words the opening sentence ("While you have the <Name> condition, you experience the following effects.") from the name and the number of effects.

effects.description: The condition's effects, in order, each printed as a bold-titled paragraph.

name.description: The effect's title, without the period: "Speed 0", "Attacks Affected".
